propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all findings on the current revision, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks whose remedy is ticket attestation rather than code change
bugfix-size-attestation findings should be accepted if the ticket carries a current valid plan-review attestation that buckets as accepted (certified, stale-code, or stale-head)

the retrigger eligibility decision must read only the bot's vote message and ticket store, never the requesting comment, and must verify the block contains exactly one finding with criterion bugfix-size-attestation

the ticket id must be resolved from the commit-message trailer via ticket_for_commit_message, not parsed from the finding detail text, and attestation validity must be verified using the gate's own classifier
attestations in FLAG_VERDICTS (absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid) or with infra verdicts (unavailable, error) must still refuse re-check-review
